notes.title: Major character and level cap update
notes.content:
[h1]Main Line Update[/h1]
The main storyline has expanded to Hell difficulty, and new challenges are coming soon. Who will break through the new limits? Let's wait and see!

[h1]Hero Optimization[/h1]
6-Star Minotaur
Talent 1: When attacked, restore health equal to 2 times your attack and gain 20% damage reduction.
Talent 2: When attacked, there is a 40% chance that the next basic attack will release a Frenzy Note, dealing 600% damage and knocking back the enemy.

Poseidon
Talent 2: Increases attack by 55%. When attacking, ignore 50% of the enemy's defense.
Talent 3: After every 2 attacks, the next attack triggers Poseidon's Arrow, dealing 700% damage to 3 enemies.

Sniper Knight
Talent 2: Increases critical hit rate by 35%. When a critical hit occurs, increase attack speed by 80%, stacking up to 5 times.

Kappa
Talent 1: Throws a shuriken dealing 600% damage, which splits into 6 directions for 400% damage upon reaching its destination. Cooldown: 5 seconds. The shuriken can freeze enemies.

Poseidon
Rage: Releases 10 water waves attacking enemies for 200% damage each. For every attack Poseidon makes, one additional water wave is generated when releasing the rage skill, with the damage of each wave increasing by 5%. Resets after releasing rage. Fixed and implemented the power that was bugged in the last update and did not take effect.

Boba Crab
Talent 3: Health +60%. When attacked, restore health equal to 5 times your defense value, with a 25% chance to freeze the enemy for 3 seconds and reduce their attack by 35% for 2 seconds.

Santa Claus
Talent 3: Adds a silence effect, capable of silencing all talents.

notes.title: 9.2update
notes.content: 1. Modify the Honor card condition to Chapter 3, originally Chapter 6

notes.title: 9.1updates
notes.content:
1. Added a deposit roll to the gift package
2. Temporarily turned off the friend invitation function, which is being reworked, and currently invites no new players
3. Merged the Glory and Abyss Hero card pools, unifying them all in the Glory Heroes
4. Optimized the difficulty of sealing the main city
5. There are other updates in the works, and future updates will follow

notes.title: 7.8update
notes.content:
Attribute ratio optimization, optimize the attack and health ratio of all heroes, health ratio has been increased

Added S and SS card attributes



Hero Optimization:

1. Rock Bull has improved its features. The attacked health ratio of Talent 1 has been adjusted. 10 Star Bull restores *1 health per attack

2. Fixed a BUG where Neptune's energy saving and description did not match

3. Increased the Crit damage factor of the target knight once again

4. Poseidon Talent 3, gain increased water wave number greatly increased

5. Greatly increased the damage of Goddess of Death

6. Greatly increased the healing effect of the Goddess of Love

7. Hellfire Talent 3 increases the passivity of life and defense, greatly increasing defense power

8. Christmas God increases attack distance and reduces dissonance after a charge

9. Abyss Lords also increased attack range, reducing dissonance after charging

10. Shadow of Darkness no longer absorbs enemies, only deals damage

11. Greatly increases the dodge value of Nightmare Talent 2
